items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Finally Papa Jo told me that he even knew, or one of his friends knew, the person that put together the first drum set

ctx.x: Well, what is it about the drummers? I mean, yes, you’ve worked with all the piano players, you played with all the great leaders. But you’ve also played with all the great drummers…
I certainly have. Brown:…I mean, your first recording is with Elvin. You know, and we can bring in everybody.
Philly Joe, Papa Jo - you name it - Shelly Manne, you name it.
